question: When was the States Reorganisation Act passed, implementing the Commission’s recommendations?
solution: The correct answer is __**1956**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **States Reorganisation Act** was passed in **1956**, and it implemented the recommendations of the **States Reorganisation Commission**. • The Act came into effect on **1st November 1956**, reorganizing states largely based on **linguistic lines**. • This Act resulted in the creation of major states like **Andhra Pradesh, Bombay, Kerala, Madras, and Punjab**, among others. • The **States Reorganisation Commission** was appointed in **1953** under the chairmanship of **Fazal Ali**. Other members included **H.N. Kunzru** and **K.M. Panikkar**. • The Act aimed to address the demands for state boundaries to be drawn based on **linguistic and cultural identities**, ensuring administrative efficiency and harmony.
